scope: Read-only current documentation, local HTML/media/evidence fingerprints and newly tracked/untracked publishable files; no workload was executed and existing evidence was not changed.

items.target: ../note.md#4-动作匹配可视化与自定义数据

evidence_scope.legacy: The 12 original SHA/hash failures remain visible; historical expected arrays/environment were not recovered and no golden values were refreshed.
evidence_scope.training: 13 smoke training runs and a 4096-environment/20-iteration teacher pilot are distinct from full default-iteration training; the docs explicitly say the full schedule has not completed.

credentials_scan.scope: Changed tracked plus nonignored untracked files only; .git metadata, ignored outputs, SSH files and unrelated directories were not read. Text and binary files were scanned without printing matched content.
credentials_scan.limitation: Pattern-based scan; this is not proof that arbitrary secret encodings or every possible provider token are absent.
